label: NONROOT_ID_BEFORE
argv: LC_ALL=C id;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_UNAME_R
argv: LC_ALL=C uname -r;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_UNAME_M
argv: LC_ALL=C uname -m;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_OS_RELEASE
argv: LC_ALL=C cat /etc/os-release;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_GLIBC
argv: LC_ALL=C rpm -q glibc;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_MEMINFO
argv: LC_ALL=C cat /proc/meminfo;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_BOOT_START
argv: LC_ALL=C cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_PS_START
argv: LC_ALL=C ps -ww -eo pid,ppid,tty,comm,args;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_DMESG_START
argv: LC_ALL=C dmesg;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_ZRAM_START
argv: LC_ALL=C cat /sys/block/zram0/mm_stat;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_ALERTS_START
argv: LC_ALL=C ls -A -- /opt/usr/share/crash/livedump;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL

label: NONROOT_ID_FINAL
argv: LC_ALL=C id;r=$?;echo;echo RC=$r;test $r = 0 && echo DONE || echo FAIL
